scenarios.name: Source/contract conformity
scenarios.planned_witness: Source tree inventory, contract checker, diff against accepted main and signed policy register

assertions.expected: all four work packages implemented
approved P01-P09 and exact instrument mapping match source
no unapproved default service, API or migration changes

assertions.expected: each metric has exact name/type/unit
no duplicate request counters
histogram produces nonzero latency samples

scenarios.name: Existing health preservation
scenarios.planned_witness: Real HTTP plus disposable DB stop/restart and health-contract regressions

assertions.expected: live stays responsive with DB down
ready goes unavailable on DB stop or absent seed within budget
existing JSON/status paths unchanged

scenarios.name: Server-controlled correlation

assertions.expected: response correlation generated on server
error and structured log scope use same value

scenarios.name: Label allowlist

assertions.expected: metric attributes contain only approved keys

scenarios.name: Cardinality and memory bound

assertions.expected: 10,000 distinct routes/identifiers stay within approved active series cap

assertions.expected: separate reviewer checks raw source, privacy, metrics and full cases

provisional_measurement_targets: P02: custom metric active-series ceiling 500 per service
P04: 10% ordinary-trace sampling, 200 spans/second, 2048 export-queue records
P09: <=10% p95 latency and <=15% peak process memory overhead
alert_thresholds: P05 initial local verification rules approved; evidence-based calibration required
